baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object ءالاء, the possessive ربكما, and the active dual verb تكذبان.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal is specified as the Lord's ongoing nurture and completion, while the Form II verb makes denial an active classification of that work as false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the interrogated object and make the question evidential rather than abstract.
Repair, nurture, and completion recast lordship as sustained formative work.
Declaring a thing or its source false makes denial a deliberate counter-verdict.

changed_reading.before: A generic question about blessings and disbelief.
changed_reading.after: A forensic challenge asking which concrete acts of nurture the two addressees will actively reclassify as false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun's ء ل و inventory and the performance-sensitive branch of تكذبان.
baseline_models.mechanism: What is bestowed can be read as enabled capacity; denial then occurs not only in speech but when a granted charge fails in execution.

activation_trace.role: Ability supplies an affordance reading of the nominal object: what the recipients have been enabled to do.
Nurture and completion explain capacity as cultivated rather than self-originating.
A charge proving true or failing makes conduct, not only assertion, the test of acknowledgment.

changed_reading.before: Denial is verbal refusal to admit a gift.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be the practical failure to carry through a capacity cultivated and entrusted by the Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath-capable branch of ءالاء, the pact branch of رب, and the direct falsification verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can carry a juridical undertone: benefaction establishes a binding claim or pledge, and denial repudiates the truth of that bond.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making supplies the binding rather than merely pleasant edge of the object.
A covenant or pact makes the Lord-recipient relation answerable and durable.
Falsehood against truth supplies breach by contradiction rather than simple ingratitude.

changed_reading.after: Which gift-established claims binding you to your Lord will you two repudiate as untrue?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative dual clause and the non-dominant ء ل و mapping to a voice that follows another voice.
baseline_models.mechanism: Even before context, the question can be heard as a call shaped to generate a following answer; its two addressees occupy a response slot, not merely an audience position.

activation_trace.role: A voice following a voice supplies an antiphonal possibility for the interrogated noun within the call.
Lordship and authority make the initiating voice a summons carrying standing.
An urging or obligating formula contributes response pressure without making it the verb's ordinary gloss.

changed_reading.before: The line reports a question to two hearers.
changed_reading.after: The line opens an authoritative response slot in which the pair must answer, perform, or expose denial through silence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The balance sequence converts the covenantal baseline into measured answerability: favors are apportioned claims, while denial resembles diminishing the due measure in recognition or conduct.

activation_trace.role: A liability or right that follows its holder lets benefaction carry a continuing claim on its recipients.
The pact image supplies the relation within which the continuing claim is owed.
Balancing two things supplies calibrated correspondence between what is given and how it is answered.
A just share or apportionment makes each favor an assigned portion rather than an unstructured abundance.
Shortchanging measure supplies the failure mode: acknowledgment can underpay what the evidence warrants.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 moves from setting the balance to forbidding excess and deficiency before the first refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calibration, just apportionment, and forbidden short measure; I infer an arrow from received portion to answerable due. A live alternative is that the sequence regulates human justice without construing favor as liability.

changed_reading.before: The pair is asked to admit that blessings exist.
changed_reading.after: The pair is asked which continuing claims of lordly benefaction they will shortchange in recognition and performance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sea sequence makes favor a productive interface: released domains meet, a limit blocks predatory overreach, and concealed luminous yield emerges from their relation.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor anchors the changed model back in the focus object.
Release into open movement initiates the dynamic rather than static relation of the two seas.
Two opposing things arriving face-to-face supplies the contact zone.
Transgressing a limit supplies the destructive alternative that the boundary prevents.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the interface's disclosed yield.
Gleaming visibility makes the emergent product evidence that can confront denial.

structural_cues: The uncited barrier construction in 55:20 stands between meeting in 55:19 and emergence in 55:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, opposed meeting, non-transgression, a barrier, and emergence; I infer that bounded contact enables the yield. A live alternative is paratactic enumeration in which the wonders are adjacent but not causally linked.

changed_reading.before: The pearls and coral are isolated valuable gifts.
changed_reading.after: The favor is the governed boundary-process itself: difference can meet without domination and disclose value unavailable to either side in isolation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ship scene sharpens capacity into navigable affordance: humanly usable movement rises within an immense medium and becomes legible through marks.

activation_trace.role: Ability anchors favor as enabled action rather than possession alone.
Flowing movement supplies the usable trajectory of the vessels.
Rising and elevation make constructed capacity conspicuous above the water.
Broad abundant water supplies the resistant yet traversable field.
A distinguishing, guiding mark turns scale and elevation into legibility.

structural_cues: 55:24 follows the focus refrain, so the next image tests whether favor includes mediated human traversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies moving raised vessels, vast water, and guiding marks; I infer that lordly gift includes the coupling of medium, craft, motion, and orientation. A live alternative treats the vessels simply as another owned marvel.

changed_reading.before: A favor is a finished object handed to the recipients.
changed_reading.after: A favor can be an operational system that lets finite agents move through an otherwise overwhelming field and read their way.

context_deltas.mechanism: Exact recurrence after changing scenes turns the focus line into a returning second voice. Each occurrence both follows the prior disclosure and solicits a reply from the dual audience.

activation_trace.role: A voice following a voice seeds the antiphonal reading in the focus noun's split inventory.
The next identical refrain realizes another answering voice after the ship image.
A further return after perishability and endurance establishes sustained call-and-response pressure.

structural_cues: The same dual interrogative recurs thirty times outside the focus while the intervening scenes and emotional valence change.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence and a branch image of one voice following another; I infer a performed call-and-response structure in which absent reply becomes meaningful. A live alternative is emphatic anaphora with no implied audience voicing.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a repeated accusation whose repetition adds emphasis.
changed_reading.after: The verse is a recurring response chamber: it follows each disclosure, recruits the pair's answer, and lets silence perform the denial it names.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near sequence of universal cessation and the Lord's enduring face revises favor's valence: a severe disclosure of what cannot last can itself be nurturing evidence that reorients attachment.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal anchors the claim that disclosure, not only pleasant possession, can count as favor.
Staying and lasting sharpen the lordly pole of the contrast.
Cessation after persistence strips created goods of imagined permanence.
Continuance supplies the non-perishing counter-pole.
Face standing for self makes endurance personal and orienting rather than an abstract duration.

structural_cues: The refrain at 55:25 is followed by total created finitude, enduring lordly presence, and another refrain at 55:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sharp perish/remain reversal; I infer that truthful disillusionment can function as nurture and thus enter the field of favors. A live alternative is that the refrain brackets separate doctrines without calling mortality itself a favor.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's favors are durable pleasant acquisitions.
changed_reading.after: Among the favors is the painful disclosure that acquisitions end, because it turns the pair toward the only enduring face.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later recognition by visible marks reverses denial's direction: the offenders try to label reality false, but their acquired offense becomes a sign that labels them truthfully.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a thing false supplies the deniers' attempted counter-label.
Recognition through a trace or sign supplies evidence that does not depend on confession.
A visible mark that makes its bearer known turns hidden stance into readable surface.
Offense supplies the condition that the marks expose.
The later explicit declaration of the encountered reality as false confirms denial as a failed labeling operation.

structural_cues: 55:39 removes questioning, 55:41 identifies by marks, and 55:43 names the very reality the offenders had denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nonverbal recognition, visible marks, offense, and later denial; I infer a reversal in which accumulated conduct becomes self-authenticating evidence. A live alternative is a simple judgment sequence with no semiotic reversal.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an opinion that can keep evidence at verbal distance.
changed_reading.after: Denial is a doomed attempt to mislabel reality, because the denier's own acquired marks become reality's answering testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored good-for-good formulation gives the refrain a reciprocity mechanism: beneficence seeks a fitting answer, and denial is the break where received good fails to become answering good.

activation_trace.role: A charge succeeding or failing lets response prove whether acknowledgment is true in action.
Meeting an act with its recompense supplies the return path from gift to answer.
Good action repeated on both sides supplies matched beneficence rather than passive appreciation.

structural_cues: 55:60 repeats the same noun on both sides of an exception construction, then 55:61 returns the refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies act-for-act recompense and mirrored beneficence; I infer that the focus question tests whether gift will propagate into fitting response. A live alternative confines reciprocity to divine reward and assigns no reciprocal duty to the addressees.

changed_reading.before: Acknowledgment is correct speech about favors.
changed_reading.after: Acknowledgment is a completed circuit in which received beneficence generates answering beneficence; denial interrupts that circuit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the occupational رب branch is narrow, but it remains anchored in ربكما and is activated by the adjacent vessels, broad water, elevation, and guiding marks. Render it only as a nautical leadership echo, never as a replacement gloss for divine lordship.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ربكما in 55:23 immediately before the vessel scene of 55:24.

activation_trace.role: A mariners' chief supplies an operational image of authoritative guidance through a difficult medium.
Flowing movement gives the leadership image an actual route.
Rising vessels make guided order visible above the sea.
A distinguishing guide-mark gives navigation a legible orientation.

changed_reading.before: Your Lord is named only as possessor of the listed gifts.
changed_reading.after: The adjacent ship image lets lordship resonate as active command that raises, routes, and marks a traversable course.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a form-distant activation from the non-dominant mapped root and cannot define ءالاء. It remains worth carrying because the focus refrain is soon followed by universal cessation and enduring remainder; downstream prose should call it a last-breath cadence, not an etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun ءالاء under its supplied split mapping, held against the nearby perish/remain reversal.

activation_trace.role: The last-breath image gives the refrain a fragile respiratory edge.
Cessation after persistence activates the edge at which breath and possession fail.
Continuance after cessation supplies the surviving counter-rhythm.

changed_reading.before: The refrain inventories favors while life continues normally.
changed_reading.after: The refrain can pulse like a question asked at the last breath: when created continuance stops, what enduring claim can still be denied?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain cloth image is surprising and should not lexicalize تكذبان, yet it is anchored in the focus verb and sharpened by later recognition through visible marks. Render it as a material analogy for self-misrepresentation that evidence eventually unmasks.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تكذبان as an active denial whose branch inventory includes an appearance that misstates its own condition.

activation_trace.role: A deceptively variegated surface supplies a material analogy for denial presenting a false condition.
A visible identifying mark supplies the truthful surface that defeats the deceptive one.
Recognition from trace or sign completes the unmasking mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be carried as a crafted false surface until accumulated marks make the bearer's actual relation to truth visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The plant-name branch is likely homonymic and cannot gloss the focus noun, but its beautiful appearance and bitter taste remain anchored in ءالاء and resonate with a surah that places pleasant vegetation beside severe disclosures. Use it only as a mixed-valence image for difficult favor.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exact focus form ءالاء and its supplied plant-name branch.

activation_trace.role: A visually attractive yet bitter plant supplies a contained image for favor whose benefit is not immediate sweetness.
The stemmed tree places the plant echo inside the surah's concrete vegetal field.
Pleasant fruit supplies the expected sweetness against which the bitter echo becomes diagnostically strange.

changed_reading.before: A favor must feel pleasant and therefore be easy to acknowledge.
changed_reading.after: Some favor may be beautiful in disclosure yet bitter in reception, so aversion alone cannot establish that it is no favor.

strongest_changes: The sea sequence changed favor from a static valuable into a bounded interface that produces otherwise hidden yield.
The balance sequence made benefaction carry measured answerability rather than invite acknowledgment alone.
Exact recurrence activated an antiphonal reading in which the refrain solicits a dual response and silence becomes performative denial.
The perish/remain reversal widened favor to include severe truth that reorients attachment.
Later visible marks reversed denial: the attempted false label is answered by evidence borne by the denier.
summary.what_was_special: The focus line remained simultaneously forensic, capacitating, covenantal, performative, ecological, navigational, temporal, and reciprocal. Its split mappings produced real but containable surprises: an answering voice, a following liability, nautical command, last-breath cadence, deceptive surface, and beautiful-but-bitter favor.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from bounded meeting to emergent yield is compelling in sequence but could be paratactic rather than explanatory.
The obligation model may overextend lexical oath, pact, and liability branches beyond the ordinary favors sense.
The antiphonal model depends on a non-dominant mapped root and should remain a performance activation, not a lexical derivation.
The ship, last-breath, cloth, and plant outliers are branch-backed echoes whose narrow scopes require explicit qualification.
